title: quercus chrysolepis var. tomentella
intro: Quercus chrysolepis var. tomentella, commonly known as Island scrub oak, is a variety of evergreen shrub or small tree native to the Channel Islands and coastal regions of California. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Quercus chrysolepis var. tomentella are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are known for their ability to modulate immune response, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
